notes:
Topline: large FS contact center (4k agents globally) evaluating Redwood for agent-assist + ticket summarization + tool-calling. Heavy compliance constraints: PCI + PHI exposure via payments/claims, must run in customer VPC or on-prem with strict retention and tenant-level audit trails.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-15: Intro call w/ Diego (AE) + Nina (SE) — discussed basic architecture, latency targets (p50 < 120ms for short assistant replies, burst handling to 50k req/min), cost profile.
- 2026-01-29: Security deep-dive w/ security engineering (Fireflies ff_2026_02_10_48). Key asks: KMS integration, HSM support, per-request audit IDs.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of agent-assist in sandbox (small agent group). Positive signal: agents liked tool-calling flow (click-to-run canned ops) but need deterministic timeouts.
- 2026-02-25: Sent detailed security questionnaire (drive:/security/vaultassist/security-answers-2026.md). Waiting on legal review.
- 2026-03-01: Procurement sync; procurement requested draft SLA and data residency clause (Fireflies ff_2026_03_01_12).
- POC planned: 4-week VPC deployment + simulated spike test (goal: <5% p90 latency increase at 5x baseline traffic) + end-to-end audit log verification. POC owner: VaultAssist infra lead (Anita Chau).

Customer requirements / notes (shorthand):
- Workloads: agent-assist (context window ~6k tokens), ticket summarization (bulk of transcripts), tool-calling to internal CRM APIs (must provide stable auth proxies), conversation reranking for escalation triage.
- Perf targets: p50 chat responses < 120ms; p95 < 400ms at baseline. Burst resilience to 5x for 10 minutes; graceful degradation w/ fallback model of smaller size.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for reserved capacity if SLA guarantees and predictable unit cost; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
- Security: SSO/SAML + IdP integration mandatory, hardware KMS or HSM for key management, full audit logging per request + 7-year retention for certain finance logs, PCI scope reduction is a goal.
- Data residency: primary requirement for US-only data; backups in a separate, auditable path.

POC success criteria (short):
1) VPC deployment completed with KMS integration and SSO SAML tested.
2) Demonstrate agent-assist latency targets under baseline and 5x burst.
3) End-to-end audit logs for 100% of tool-calls and redaction proof on PHI-containing transcripts.
4) Runbook for failover and fallback model routing documented.

Quotes / customer color: "Need predictable behavior during holiday spikes — last year our system slowed and agents had to manually escalate. If you can prove deterministic fallbacks, we can push this across 3 regions." — Lead, Customer Support Ops.

Open items / blocking details:
- Legal wants insertion of explicit data residency clause in Master Services Agreement (MSA).
- Security questionnaire: 12 items marked as high risk (encryption at rest/in transit, key handling, audit trail immutability).
- Procurement needs final TCO comparison to incumbent (Zendesk AI + homegrown middleware).

- Nina to stand up POC design doc and estimated infra cost (drive:/poc/vaultassist/poc-plan-v2.xlsx).
